title: Add bilingual platform store badges and availability states to the DappGo homepage
question: Can the homepage show a professional, accurate Android/iOS choice for every DappGo app without creating dead links or changing app releases?
hypotheses: A shared badge component with verified URLs and explicit disabled Coming soon states will make platform availability understandable without affecting app binaries.
acceptance_criteria: Every app card exposes both Android and iOS platform states.
Verified Android/iOS URLs are clickable only when available; unavailable iOS states are visibly Coming soon and not focusable.
Light/dark themes, English/Traditional Chinese, keyboard order, mobile widths and external-link security are verified.
The supplied store-badge asset is stored locally and used consistently without changing mobile apps, AdSense configuration or data services.
The merged homepage is deployed through the existing website release path and public links are rechecked.
evidence: Owner requested implementation, platform verification, merge and deployment after the existing design and technical documents.
Store destinations are recorded in the preceding WEBSITE-PRODUCT-DESIGN-20261011/LINKS.md and are revalidated during this work item.
